description_en: Adds one or more compute nodes to a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用AddNodes添加一个或多个计算节点到指定集群
name: AddNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster to which you want to add nodes.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
待添加节点的集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The image type. Valid values:
system: public image
self: custom image
others: shared image
marketplace: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image

Default value: system
parameters.help_zh:
镜像类型。取值范围：
system：公共镜像
self：自定义镜像
others：共享镜像
marketplace：镜像市场镜像

默认值：system
parameters.name: image_owner_alias

parameters.help_en:
The image specified for the compute nodes to be added to the cluster. The image must meet the following conditions:

The operating system of the specified image must be the same as the operating system of the nodes in the cluster. For example, if the operating system of the nodes in the cluster is CentOS, you can only specify a CentOS image.
If the cluster is a hybrid cloud cluster and the multi-operating system feature is enabled, when the operating system of the nodes in the cluster is Windows, the specified image can be Windows or CentOS.

The major version number of the specified image must be the same as the major version number of the image used by the nodes in the cluster. For example, if the cluster uses CentOS 7.x, the specified image must also be CentOS 7.x.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html operations to query the image ID
parameters.help_zh:
为待加入集群的计算节点指定的镜像，该镜像需满足以下条件：

指定的镜像的操作系统应与集群中节点的操作系统保持一致。如：集群中节点的操作系统为CentOS时，只能指定CentOS镜像。
如果集群为混合云集群，并且开启支持多系统功能，当集群中节点的操作系统为Windows时，指定的镜像可以为Windows、CentOS。

指定的镜像应与集群节点的镜像大版本号保持一致，如待加入集群为CentOS 7.x，指定的镜像也应该为CentOS 7.x。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87213.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87215.html接口获取镜像ID
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of compute nodes to add. Valid values: 1 to 99. The value must be greater than the value of MinCount.

If the ECS inventory is less than the value of MinCount, the nodes fail to be added.

If the ECS inventory is greater than the value of MinCount but less than the value of Count, the number of nodes added is equal to the value of MinCount.

If the ECS inventory is greater than the value of Count, the number of nodes added is equal to the value of Count
parameters.help_zh:
添加的计算节点数量。取值范围：1~99，并且MinCount<Count。

ECS库存数量<MinCount，添加节点失败。

MinCount<ECS库存数量<Count，按照MinCount指定的数量添加节点。

Count<ECS库存数量，按照Count指定的数量添加节点
parameters.name: count

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the scale-out nodes. By default, the instance type of the compute nodes used during the last scale-out or cluster creation is used
parameters.help_zh: 扩容的实例规格，默认使用上次扩容或者创建集群时的计算节点实例规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The preemption policy for the compute nodes. This parameter takes effect only when the EcsChargeType parameter is set to PostPaid. Valid values:
NoSpot: pay-as-you-go instance
SpotWithPriceLimit: spot instance with a maximum hourly price
SpotAsPriceGo: spot instance for which the system automatically places a bid based on the current market price

Default value: NoSpot
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点抢占策略。当参数EcsChargeType取值为PostPaid时才生效。取值范围：
NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认值：NoSpot
parameters.name: compute_spot_strategy

parameters.help_en: The maximum hourly price for the compute nodes. The value can be accurate to three decimal places. This parameter takes effect only when the SpotStrategy parameter is set to SpotWithPriceLimit
parameters.help_zh: 计算节点每小时最高价格，支持最多3位小数。参数SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时生效
parameters.name: compute_spot_price_limit

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the nodes in the cluster. Valid values:
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
PrePaid: subscription

Default value: PostPaid.

If you select the subscription billing method, auto-renewal is enabled by default. After the cluster is released, auto-renewal is disabled for the nodes
parameters.help_zh:
集群使用节点的付费类型。取值范围：
PostPaid：按量付费
PrePaid：包年包月

默认值：PostPaid

若选择包年包月类型，默认开启自动续费，集群释放后节点将关闭自动续费
parameters.name: ecs_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period of the resources. The unit is specified by the PeriodUnit parameter. This parameter is required and takes effect only when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid. Valid values:
When PeriodUnit is set to Week, valid values of Period are 1, 2, 3, and 4.
When PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values of Period are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长，单位由PeriodUnit指定。当参数InstanceChargeType取值为PrePaid时才生效且为必选值。取值范围：
PeriodUnit=Week时，Period取值：{“1”, “2”, “3”, “4”}。
PeriodUnit=Month时，Period取值：{“1”, “2”, “3”, “4”, “5”, “6”, “7”, “8”, “9”, “12”, “24”, “36”, ”48”, ”60”}。

默认值：1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period of the resources. Valid values:
Week
Month

Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长。取值范围：
Week
Month

默认值：Month
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter takes effect only when the EcsChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal
false: disables auto-renewal

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，当参数EcsChargeType取值为PrePaid时才生效。取值范围：
true：自动续费
false：不自动续费

默认值：true
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. This parameter takes effect only when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true.
When PeriodUnit is set to Week, valid values of AutoRenewPeriod are 1, 2, and 3.
When PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values of AutoRenewPeriod are 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
每次自动续费的时长。参数AutoRenew取值true时生效。
PeriodUnit为Week时，AutoRenewPeriod取值{"1", "2", "3"}。
PeriodUnit为Month时，AutoRenewPeriod取值{"1", "2", "3", "6", "12"}。

默认值：1
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The name of the queue to which the compute nodes are added
parameters.help_zh: 计算节点加入的队列名称
parameters.name: job_queue

parameters.help_en:
The method used to create the nodes. Valid values:
manual: manual scale-out
autoscale: automatic scale-out

Default value: manual
parameters.help_zh:
节点创建方式。取值范围：
manual：手动扩容
autoscale：自动扩容

默认值：manual
parameters.name: create_mode

parameters.help_en:
The category of the system cloud disk. Valid values:
cloud_efficiency: ultra disk
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: ESSD
cloud: basic disk (discontinued)

Default value: cloud_efficiency
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘的云盘类型。取值范围：
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
cloud：普通云盘，已停售。

默认值：cloud_efficiency
parameters.name: system_disk_type

parameters.help_en:
The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB.

Valid values: 40 to 500.

Default value: 40
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘的大小。单位：GiB

取值范围：40~500

默认值：40
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The hostname prefix. This helps you classify and manage nodes
parameters.help_zh: 主机名前缀。方便您分类管理节点
parameters.name: host_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The hostname suffix. This helps you classify and manage nodes
parameters.help_zh: 主机名后缀。方便您分类管理节点
parameters.name: host_name_suffix

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the compute nodes support hyper-threading. Valid values:
true: supports hyper-threading
false: does not support hyper-threading

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点是否支持超线程。取值范围：
true：支持超线程
false：不支持超线程

默认值：true
parameters.name: compute_enable_ht

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to assign a public IP address. Valid values:
true: assigns a public IP address
false: does not assign a public IP address

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否分配公网地址。取值范围：
true：分配公网地址
false：不分配公网地址

默认值：false
parameters.name: allocate_public_address

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the elastic IP address (EIP). Valid values:
PayByBandwidth: pay-by-bandwidth
PayByTraffic: pay-by-traffic
parameters.help_zh:
弹性公网IP付费类型。取值范围：
PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽收费
PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费
parameters.name: internet_charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The maximum inbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

If the purchased outbound public bandwidth is less than or equal to 10 Mbit/s, valid values are 1 to 10. Default value: 10.
If the purchased outbound public bandwidth is greater than 10 Mbit/s, valid values are 1 to the value of InternetMaxBandWidthOut. Default value: the value of InternetMaxBandWidthOut
parameters.help_zh:
公网入带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：

当所购公网出带宽小于等于10Mbit/s时：1~10，默认为10。
当所购公网出带宽大于10Mbit/s时：1~InternetMaxBandWidthOut的取值，默认为InternetMaxBandWidthOut的取值
parameters.name: internet_max_band_width_in

parameters.help_en:
The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values: 0 to 100.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
公网出带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。取值范围：0~100

默认值：0
parameters.name: internet_max_band_width_out

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the ESSD used as the system cloud disk. Valid values:
PL0: A single ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

For more information about ESSD performance parameters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.help_zh:
创建ESSD云盘作为系统盘使用时，设置云盘的性能等级。取值范围：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

默认值：PL1

更多ESSD性能参数，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: system_disk_level

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of nodes to add. Valid values: 1 to 99. The value must be less than the value of Count.

If the ECS inventory is less than the value of MinCount, the nodes fail to be added.

If the ECS inventory is greater than the value of MinCount but less than the value of Count, the number of nodes added is equal to the value of MinCount.

If the ECS inventory is greater than the value of Count, the number of nodes added is equal to the value of Count.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
指定最小添加的节点数量。取值范围：1~99，并且MinCount<Count。

ECS库存数量<MinCount，添加节点失败。

MinCount<ECS库存数量<Count，按照MinCount指定的数量添加节点。

Count<ECS库存数量，按照Count指定的数量添加节点。

默认值：1
parameters.name: min_count

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to set this operation as a synchronous operation. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否设置该接口为同步接口。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

默认值：false
parameters.name: sync

fields.help_en:
The category of the Nth data cloud disk that is created along with the nodes. Valid values:

cloud_efficiency: ultra disk

cloud_ssd: standard SSD

cloud_essd: ESSD

cloud: basic disk

Default value: cloud_efficiency.

Valid values of N: 0 to 16
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘类型。可能值：

cloud_efficiency：高效云盘

cloud_ssd：SSD云盘

cloud_essd：ESSD云盘

cloud：普通云盘

默认值：cloud_efficiency

N的取值范围：0~16
fields.name: data_disk_category

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to release the Nth data cloud disk that is created along with the nodes when the instance is released. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no

Default value: true.

Valid values of N: 0 to 16
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘是否随实例释放。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

默认值：true

N的取值范围：0~16
fields.name: data_disk_delete_with_instance

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the Nth data cloud disk that is created along with the nodes. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no

Default value: false.

Valid values of N: 0 to 16
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘是否加密。取值范围：

true：是

false：否

默认值：false

N的取值范围：0~16
fields.name: data_disk_encrypted

fields.help_en:
The ID of the KMS key used by the Nth data cloud disk that is created along with the nodes.

Valid values of N: 0 to 16
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘使用的KMS密钥ID。

N的取值范围：0~16
fields.name: data_disk_kms_key_id

fields.help_en:
The performance level of the Nth data cloud disk created along with the nodes when the disk category is ESSD. This parameter takes effect only when the DataDisks.N.DataDiskCategory parameter is set to cloud_essd. Valid values:
PL0: A single ESSD can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL1: A single ESSD can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL2: A single ESSD can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.
PL3: A single ESSD can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS.

Default value: PL1.

Valid values of N: 0 to 16
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘类型为ESSD云盘时，区分性能等级。仅当DataDisks.N.DataDiskCategory=cloud_essd时该参数有效。取值范围：
PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万
PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万
PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万
PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万

默认值：PL1

N的取值范围：0~16
fields.name: data_disk_performance_level

fields.help_en:
The size of the Nth data cloud disk that is created along with the nodes. Unit: GB.

Valid values: 40 to 500.

Default value: 40.

Valid values of N: 0 to 16
fields.help_zh:
第N个随节点创建的数据盘容量大小。单位：GB

取值范围：40~500

默认值：40

N的取值范围：0~16
fields.name: data_disk_size

parameters.help_en: The list of data cloud disks that are created along with the nodes
parameters.help_zh: 随节点创建的数据盘信息列表
parameters.name: data_disks

parameters.help_en: The protection period of the spot instance. Unit: hours. Valid values: 0 and 1. A value of 0 indicates the no protection period mode. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 抢占式实例的保护期，单位为小时。取值范围为0~1，设置为0表示无保护期，默认为1
parameters.name: compute_spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The interruption pattern of the spot instance. Currently, only Terminate (default) is supported, which directly releases the instance
parameters.help_zh: 抢占实例中断模式。目前仅支持Terminate（默认）直接释放实例
parameters.name: compute_spot_interruption_behavior

parameters.help_en:
The communication mode of the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values:

Standard: uses the TCP communication mode.


HighPerformance: enables the Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) and uses the RDMA communication mode
parameters.help_zh:
网卡的通讯模式。参数取值范围：

Standard：使用TCP通讯模式。


HighPerformance：开启ERI（Elastic RDMA Interface）接口，使用RDMA通讯模式
parameters.name: network_interface_traffic_mode

parameters.help_en: The DNS configuration information
parameters.help_zh: DNS配置信息
parameters.name: dns_config
